notes.title: Network Master - May Devlog
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

In this post, we would like to give you a glimpse of what awaits you in the next Update. In addition to a quite a few bug fixes, we focused on developing the network 🌐

Connecting cables to the server

We will add switches and patch panels in servers, which will be necessary to connect a large number of computers to the network 🖥️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161644/84be896dcac5990690e2ba918415ffea8b1700ac.png

Connecting network devices

In addition to configuring the network, devices need to be physically connected by cable. There will be routers and wall sockets to connect 🛜

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161644/8d2141ebd5c575284f14aa7626c2ca27b26d30a5.png

Building a physical network

It is also necessary to run cables to different rooms, sockets and expand the physical network 🛠️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161644/fa0551844640e9b436ac0e387acfe085cf712ce5.png

New rooms

We will also add new offices and rooms, specially prepared for these missions 🏢

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161644/7c45208554760ac92ffa5be4294715caede5041d.png

New items in the shop

In order to perform missions you will need the right equipment, so we have added it to the shop. You will find there, for example, cables and routers 🛒

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161644/815af94c4766c369a34556e8c28ffdb25e2c7db5.png


We hope you enjoyed this teaser!
See you soon,
ServiceIT Team

In less than 100 hours we will start our voyage in Early Access. What does it mean? We want to deliver you the best experience possible but we are quite a small indie studio. From now on we are going to listen to you the community of ServiceIT: You can do IT to your feedback, your opinions, and your ideas.

Firstly we will answer probably the most important questions.

It's 12.99$ and with a launch discount of a minimum of 5% as we have passed 700 followers. Now is the time to go higher. 800 = 10%!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161644/b18ac7cfc8dab0c6ac4c521150e2e44b1b4be29a.png

Every language that you see on the Steam card of the game. If you can't find yours, write to us. Maybe we can add it later.

Yes, quite a lot. The best to find them all is to type after the release on Steam "ServiceIT"

5. What will I get in Early Access?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771120/906d5519875f319ece9079f0ea6782184baed0f7.jpg


 🖱️ The first story arc will be available, dealing with the fight against an unknown hacker and the corporation behind him
 ⚡️ Over 20 missions that will allow you to develop the website
 💻 7 courses that will teach the player the secrets of IT (courses: soldering [repairing boards], network management, course on repairing boards with THT elements, course on installing an operating system, programming course, server management course, terminal use course)
 💵 Marketplace - where you can buy used, broken tiles and sell them at a profit after repairing them

 🖨️ Ability to interact with the printer and a hidden room on the main map
 ⭐️ Achievements
 ❤️ Our heart and love for games



6. How will the game change through EA?

Based on the fan feedback 
a) Gameplay improvements as the game and its community grows
b) More equipment
c) More Achievements
d) New mechanics
e) More into the story

It mostly depends on you, if you like it, we can make it.

7. Will we have a launch stream?
Yes. It will start on the day of release.
